summary: /v1/sessions/:sessionKey/memory/remember reprocessed already extracted messages and duplicated memory_items for the same session/message set.
source_evidence: src/sessions/services/friday-session-memory-extraction-service.ts: extractSpecificMessages now splits out memory_extract_status=extracted before processInline; test/unit/sessions/services/friday-session-memory-extraction-service.test.ts covers the regression.
notes: Discovered while rerunning ISSUE-00117; fixed by making repeated remember on already extracted messages idempotent. Fresh main-runtime rerun shows processedMessageCount=0 and memoryItemsDelta=0.

summary: POST /v1/agent/runs can complete in 0ms with toolCallCount=0 and zero usage, returning a canned capability summary instead of honoring an explicit provider-pinned skill_run task.
notes: Root cause confirmed: CAPABILITY_QUERY in friday-execution-classifier matched the incidental substring "is blocked or disabled" inside imperative agent tasks, so /v1/agent/runs misclassified explicit skill_run instructions as sync_immediate capability queries and returned the canned Current capabilities response with durationMs=0 and no execution trace. Source now narrows state-query matching to whole capability questions, the regression test locks the failing task text, isolated rerun proves the short-circuit is gone, and a fresh main-runtime run now executes the real agent/tool path with tool_start/tool_end plus a truthful node-skill disabled blocker response.
